messages:
maria: FYI — planning to flip the new role-mapping replay for the Redwood Console at 11:30PT. Need quick checks on two things: (1) audit events include KMS key id after rotation, (2) UI gating for the editor 'Edit' button respects newly split permissions.

sahil: on it. I ran the policy replay locally against the prod-like dataset, found ~14 sessions where viewer->editor mapping would have toggled the button.

jordan: which audit stream are we validating? cloudwatch or the internal kafka topic?

maria: kafka (rbac-events.v2) is primary. But also check the KMS-encrypted payload in s3/audit-raw. We had a prior bug where rotated keys left old ciphertext blobs unverifiable.

olga: I pulled the replay output. Two classes of failures: decryption errors for old key blobs (ERR_KMS_DECRYPT) and event schema mismatch (missing "effect" field).

kyung: ERR_KMS_DECRYPTs are expected if key alias changed without rewrap. Did we run the rewrap job for the 2026-03 rotation?

maria: supposed to be done by infra-runbook v3 but I see partial run logs. @dev-bot show last rewrap job status for key alias redwood-console-audit-2026

dev-bot: job rewrap-2026-03-14 completed: 82% success, 18% failed (targets: s3://audit-raw/part-*/2026-03/*). See run: https://infra/jobs/rewrap-2026-03-14

sahil: 18% fail matches the decrypt errors. Those events came from two buckets in eu-west1 where IAM policy temporarily blocked rewrap agent.

jordan: For UI gating — the front-end decision function consults /v1/roles/effective for a user. If the role-matrix migration changed "can_edit_project" semantics from inherited to explicit, we may see silent button hiding.

olga: We should avoid a hard-hide in the canary. Recommend feature-flagging the new gating so fallback path shows a tooltip + request access flow instead of fully removing the action.

kyung: Agreed. Also audit needs to capture both pre-migration and post-migration role attributes so we can run diffs. Add fields: prior_roles and migrated_roles (both redacted but present).

maria: Good. Action items:
- sahil: open infra ticket to re-run rewrap for the two failed buckets and attach verification logs (due 2h).
- jordan: add a canary flag and return the tooltip fallback for editor button when flag=canary (due 3h).
- olga: patch replay analyzer to mark ERR_KMS_DECRYPT events and link to bucket/obj (due 1h).
- kyung: add migrated_roles and prior_roles to rbac-events.v2 payload (schema bump minor) and coordinate with audits team (due EOD).

sahil: starting rewrap now. will post logs here.

dev-bot: deploy started: rbac-console-gating-canary @ 1758211200 by jordan (sha: a1b2c3).

jordan: deploying canary to 5% of sessions in us-west for now. Keeping fallback tooltip.

maria: If rewrap job fails again we need rollback criteria. Proposed: roll back mapping flip if post-rollout decrypt errors > 1% of recent 24h events or any ERR_KMS_DECRYPT on admin-level actions.

kyung: Sounds safe. Also ensure the telemetry exports include sample ciphertexts for debugging (redact plaintext).

olga: replay analyzer update done — it flags 18 failed objects and lists S3 locations. I'll post the list.

sahil: rewrap finished: 100% success after retry with elevated agent role. Logs: https://infra/jobs/rewrap-1758212000/logs. No further ERR_KMS_DECRYPT in a quick run.

maria: Great. Jordan — hold canary until we get a full day of clean audit events. If no regressions, proceed to 25% then full.

jordan: ack. Holding.

maria: small one: add an explicit audit event when the front-end hides an action due to gating so SRE can correlate user-reported missing buttons with role-diff events.

kyung: will add event: ui_action_blocked {action, user_id_hash, reason:"role_gated", prior_roles, migrated_roles}. Hashes only.

maria: Thanks. If anything unexpected crops up ping #oncall. I'll update the runbook with these rollback thresholds.

olga: posted s3 list and the analyzer diff.

jordan: canary held at 0.05. No UI errors reported so far.

maria: closing for now — will re-open thread if rollback triggers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
